card.name: First digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: The leading digit of a two-digit number, most often the 3 in 36°F (after 2° to 8°C) in storage temperatures. Also the first digit of dates, section numbers and day ranges.

modes.label: Fahrenheit refrigeration range
modes.description: The 3 of 36°F right after a Celsius range of 2 to 8.
modes.example: (infusion completed) within 12 hours at room temperature or 24 hours if refrigerated (2° to 8°C, <<3>>6° to 46°F).

modes.label: Dates and section numbers
modes.description: The first digit of a day in a date or a numbered section, such as 23 April or 30 May or section 10.

card.writes: It promotes digit tokens, so it helps the model write the next digit of a number.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a two-digit number, mainly the 3 in 36°F, and prepares the next digit.
